current_threat_window.rule: Current threat indices and current summary blocks use only events published inside the latest 14 UTC calendar days. Historical events remain scored and stored separately.

method.description: Threat Score Engine v3.2. All clustered events are scored and preserved historically. Current threat indices and top-level summaries use only the latest 14 UTC calendar days. Full-history summaries are stored in historical_summaries.

index_method.operational_index: Average of the five highest scoring current incident/activity events.
index_method.early_warning_index: Average of the eight highest scoring current indicator events.
index_method.threat_index: 80% Operational Index + 20% Early Warning Index when current operational events exist. Otherwise the Early Warning Index.
index_method.current_summaries: Top-level country, category, actor, subtype and scope summaries use the same current 14-day event window.
index_method.historical_retention: Historical events remain in the scored dataset and historical summaries without retention loss.

current_events.title: PM: Estonia ready to immediately close border in case of Russian mobilization
current_events.summary: Estonia is preparing for possible security risks if Russia declares a general mobilization, with Prime Minister Kristen Michal saying the country could close its border immediately if the threat assessment warrants it.
related_titles: PM: Estonia ready to immediately close border in case of Russian mobilization

current_events.title: Kaja Kallas: Russia using hybrid attacks to erode Europe's support for Ukraine
current_events.summary: The European Union's High Representative for Foreign Affairs, Kaja Kallas, said that Russia's increasing hybrid attacks, acts of sabotage, and stray drones are aimed at frightening the residents of European countries and deterring them from supporting Ukraine.
related_titles: Kaja Kallas: Russia using hybrid attacks to erode Europe's support for Ukraine

items.title: My home is not my castle: Kaliningrad as an address for Kremlin propaganda. Part 2
items.summary: In official discourse, Kaliningrad is increasingly portrayed as Russia’s western fortress: resilient, patriotic, and under constant external pressure. items.title: From denial to exploitation: how the Kremlin has adapted its climate disinformation
items.summary: In the latest wave of climate-related narratives spread by the Kremlin, climate change is a vehicle to reinforce familiar disinformation tropes: the alleged authoritarianism and hypocrisy of the EU, Europe's supposed self-inflicted decline through sanctions against Russia, and, ultimately, the claim that Europe has no choice but to restore relations with Russia as a supplier of affordable oil and gas. The post From denial to exploitation: how the Kremlin has adapted its climate disinformation appeared first on EUvsDisinfo .
related_titles: From denial to exploitation: how the Kremlin has adapted its climate disinformation

items.summary: Russia’s strike on Kyiv Pechersk Lavra damaged a UNESCO site and exposed the Kremlin's disinformation narrative of protecting Orthodoxy, amid wider attacks on Ukraine’s culture. The post Russia’s attacks on Ukraine’s cultural heritage: a nail in the coffin of FIMI appeared first on EUvsDisinfo .

items.title: Explosives and propaganda: Russia’s dual-use drones
items.summary: Russian First Person View (FPV) drones have become a defining feature of the war in Ukraine. The same drones used to drop explosives on civilians and military targets are also being used to distribute propaganda leaflets in frontline communities, combining physical violence with psychological warfare. The post Explosives and propaganda: Russia’s dual-use drones appeared first on EUvsDisinfo .
related_titles: Explosives and propaganda: Russia’s dual-use drones

items.title: How Moscow tries to cover up its failures on the Ukrainian battlefield
items.summary: As Russia's military gains slow and Ukraine intensifies strikes on key targets, the Kremlin is increasingly turning to exaggerated victory claims and disinformation to hide setbacks on the battlefield.
